# Vagelis Tsopanos

> Front-end developer based in Greece, building SaaS dashboards, business tools, and data-driven interfaces with Angular, React, and TypeScript.

## About

Vagelis Tsopanos is a front-end developer specializing in dashboards, admin panels, and business applications. Core stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, React, React Native, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Electron, Sass. Focused on accessible, data-heavy interfaces for SaaS products.
